clips.title: The story
paras: In the Wetlands, hunters prepare crocolisk skins for Menethil Harbor. The hides are valuable trade goods for local leatherworkers.

Crocolisk hides are an essential trade good for coastal Menethil Harbor. Hunters gather and cure the tough, water-resistant skins in the Wetlands before sending them west to artisans such as James Halloran. Einar has gathered this bundle, but asks a traveler to carry it into town. He wants to avoid returning home to face the temper of his frustrated wife, Sida.
